parsed.note_claim: This video is from the 2022 Kerch Crimean Bridge explosion, not the King Fahd Bridge.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: CCTV footage appears to show the moment the bridge linking Crimea and Russia was hit by a huge explosion early on Saturday morning.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly identifies the footage as depicting the Kerch bridge explosion in October 2022.
